title: Speed Webb's band
summary: Speed Webb's band was as good as Lunceford's but never reached New York.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So then I went with Speed Webb. That was a good band. A very good band. I just wish that band could have got to New York, to ...(?)...(?)... I think that band would have still been going today. That band was as good as Lunceford's or any of those bands, really.
Yeah, everybody I've talked to who was in that band, Vic and Teddy, they all say the same thing -- it was a great band.
